summary: Estimate one scan-bound sequence-specific non-Cartesian phase model from non-Cartesian phase-reference data.
notes: This reserves artifacts distinct from ksj.phase-reference-frame and ksj.phase-model: a non-Cartesian sequence must define its reference acquisition, trajectory/sample association, echo or readout dependence, phase convention, key projection, completion, finite retention, resource bounds, and terminal behavior in a future exact contract. The immutable ksj.noncartesian-phase-model reaches noncartesian_phase_correct only through an explicit calibration binding; it is never implicit Provider state.
